items.title: Identifying Secure Collaboration Platforms (e.g., Google Workspace, MS Teams)

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Identifying Secure Collaboration Platforms (e.g., Google Workspace, MS Teams) under 9.1 as printed (PDF 125, printed 121).

blocks.text: Secure collaboration platforms such as Google Workspace and Microsoft Teams provide protected environments for group work. These platforms use features like encrypted communication and access controls to safeguard data. Students can share documents, attend meetings, and communicate safely. Choosing trusted and approved platforms helps protect information and reduces cyber risks. For example, students can use Google Workspace for school projects by sharing a project file only with selected classmates through restricted access. They can also use Google Meet for secure online classes, where only authorized participants are allowed to join. These features help students collaborate safely while protecting their schoolwork and personal information.
